description: Legacy website fallback: get the official authenticated viewing-request form for one exact previously returned individual property reference. Prefer open_findestate_enquiry to display the guest form inside ChatGPT without FindEstate login. This read-only tool creates no request and does not book an appointment. Offer the returned requestUrl so the user can sign in to FindEstate, review their contact details and recipient, and explicitly send a request to the catalog team inbox. Never collect contact or card details in this tool, claim a request was sent, reserve property, or charge a deposit. A project summary is not a selectable apartment. Current GEO and MCP permissions are rechecked.
name: prepare_findestate_viewing
title: Request a FindEstate viewing
